root_causes.description: The recommendation service exhibits extreme server-side latency: its p99 is pinned at the 10000ms histogram ceiling while reporting zero errors, and its request spans run ~15s. This latency propagates upstream to frontend/checkout (both depend on recommendation), producing the cluster-wide P99 latency watchdog alert.

evidence.observed_value: p99=10000.000 ms (mean=p50=p95=p99=max=10000, saturated at histogram ceiling)
evidence.expected_baseline: p99 in single-digit/low-hundred ms range for a healthy recommendation server span
error_rate < 0.01 — confirms latency fault, not an error/abort fault

evidence.observed_value: user_browse_product span duration=15001ms, status=ok (search_traces: 20 traces, 0 errors, p95_duration=30008ms)
evidence.expected_baseline: recommendation browse spans ~tens of ms; healthy p95 far below 30s
cpu_stress would show a multi-fold CPU spike; here CPU is low, ruling out cpu_stress

evidence.query_or_id: [no K8s events found] (get_pod_events namespace=otel-demo pod_name_prefix=recommendation since_seconds=600)
evidence.expected_baseline: pod_crash would surface restart/backoff events — none observed

root_causes.description: recommendation depends on product-catalog; a slow downstream product-catalog could block recommendation request handling and produce the ~15s spans. However, product-catalog CPU is normal (~2.7 s/s) and no product-catalog error spike was observed, so this is a weaker alternative.

evidence.observed_value: cpu_usage mean=2.726 s/s (p50=2.774, max=2.873) — no anomalous spike
evidence.expected_baseline: a saturating product-catalog dependency would show elevated/erratic CPU or error surfacing

evidence.observed_value: no data returned for product-catalog server-span p99
evidence.expected_baseline: inconclusive — cannot attribute latency to product-catalog from available data

root_causes.description: frontend depends on recommendation; the recommendation latency propagates to frontend, which is the entry point for the load-generator and the likely alert surface — a symptom rather than the origin.

evidence.observed_value: error_rate mean=0.004, max=0.010 (near-zero errors, no error spike)
evidence.expected_baseline: error_rate < 0.01 — frontend shows latency propagation, not an error fault

remediation_steps: Scale out the recommendation deployment (increase replicas / CPU-memory headroom) to relieve saturated request handling producing ~15s server spans.
Instrument and inspect the recommendation → product-catalog client-span path to confirm whether recommendation is blocked on a slow downstream dependency rather than its own processing.
Verify recommendation pod resource limits/requests and check for cgroup CPU throttling even though aggregate CPU is low.
Add a latency-based alert on recommendation server-span p99 to catch saturation before it propagates to frontend/checkout.
